system.description:
You pour a brief jolt of counterfeit life into a corpse, making it twitch, sit up or flail, a sight that unnerves any who witness the mobile dead.

Expend one Blood Trait; the body then twitches or moves briefly however you dictate. If you also expend a Physical Trait, you may instead implant a single command, causing the corpse to move once as directed when a certain event comes to pass. Corpses moved this way cannot attack or inflict damage, but they readily startle the unwary.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
